composition_strategy: A central-focal composition with an oblique viewpoint, emphasizing a right-centric focus to create a sense of dynamic tension.
focal_strategy: The focal point is strategically placed to the right and in the middle of the frame, drawing the viewer's attention to the central subject while maintaining visual balance.
depth_strategy: The shallow depth plan is used to keep the scene from appearing overly cluttered, maintaining a clean and focused visual experience.
border_or_perimeter_strategy: The open perimeter plan ensures that the scene appears unconstrained and allows for a natural flow of visual elements.
title_safe_region_strategy: The title-safe region is positioned at the upper part of the frame to avoid overlapping with the main focal point, ensuring readability.
programme_safe_region_strategy: The programme-safe region is strategically placed at the lower part of the frame, ensuring that it does not interfere with the primary visual elements of the scene.
